# Vintrack Support

Choose the channel that matches your question:

- **Setup and usage:** read
  [Getting Started](../docs/getting-started.md),
  [Configuration](../docs/configuration.md), and
  [Troubleshooting](../docs/troubleshooting.md).
- **Community help:** join the
  [Vintrack Discord](https://discord.gg/WbEpEjaWjP).
- **Reproducible bugs:** open a
  [bug report](https://github.com/JakobAIOdev/Vintrack-Vinted-Monitor/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml).
- **Feature proposals:** open a
  [feature request](https://github.com/JakobAIOdev/Vintrack-Vinted-Monitor/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml).
- **Security vulnerabilities:** follow the private process in
  [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).

When requesting help, include the Vintrack version, deployment method, affected
component, and a short redacted log excerpt. Never post `.env` contents, session
tokens, OAuth secrets, webhook URLs, proxy credentials, or personal data.

Vintrack is community-maintained. Response times are best effort, and the public
demo is not an SLA-backed hosted service.
